table.name: version_ver
table.description: History of all version upgrades applied to this database

table.name: person_per
table.description: This contains the main person data, including person names, person addresses, person phone numbers, and foreign keys to the family table

column.name: per_DateDeceased
column.description: Date the person died; NULL means living/unknown

table.name: whycame_why
table.description: This contains the comments related to why people came

table.name: person_custom
table.description: Person custom fields

table.name: person_custom_master
table.description: This contains definitions for the custom person fields

table.name: family_fam
table.description: This contains the main family data, including family name, family addresses, and family phone numbers

table.name: note_nte
table.description: Contains all person and family notes, including the date, time, and person who entered the note

table.name: config_cfg
table.description: This table contains all non-default configuration parameter names and values

table.name: group_grp
table.description: This contains the name and description for each group, as well as foreign keys to the list of group roles

column.name: grp_Type
column.description: The group type. This is defined in list_lst.OptionId where lst_ID=3

column.name: grp_RoleListID
column.description: The lst_ID containing the names of the roles for this group

column.name: grp_DefaultRole
column.description: The ID of the default role in this group's RoleList

column.name: grp_include_email_export
column.description: Should members of this group be included in MailChimp Export

table.name: groupprop_master
table.description: This contains definitions for the group-specific fields

table.name: person2group2role_p2g2r
table.description: This table stores the information of which people are in which groups, and what group role each person holds in that group

table.name: deposit_dep
table.description: This records deposits / payments

table.name: donationfund_fun
table.description: This contains the defined donation funds

table.name: event_attend
table.description: this indicates which people attended which events

table.name: events_event
table.description: This contains events

table.name: pledge_plg
table.description: This contains all payment/pledge information

table.name: pledge_denominations_pdem
table.description: Cash denomination counts recorded per pledge/payment GroupKey for a deposit (cash-counting workflow). Column plg_depID mirrors the name used in FinancialService raw SQL.

table.name: list_lst
table.description: This table stores the options for most of the drop down lists in churchCRM, including person classifications, family roles, group types, group roles, group-specific property types, and custom field value lists.

column.name: lst_ID
column.description: The ID of the list. Since this is a composite primary key, there may be multiple List IDs

column.name: lst_OptionID
column.description: The ID of the option in this list. ***List ID + List Option ID must be unique***

column.name: lst_OptionSequence
column.description: The order in which to display items in this list

column.name: lst_OptionName
column.description: The actual value for this list option

table.name: user_usr
table.description: This contains the login information and specific settings for each ChurchCRM user

table.name: volunteeropportunity_vol
table.description: This contains the names and descriptions of volunteer opportunities

table.name: queryparameters_qrp
table.description: defines the parameters for each query

table.name: kioskdevice_kdev
table.description: This contains a list of all (un)registered kiosk devices

column.name: kdev_GUIDHash
column.description: SHA256 Hash of the GUID stored in the kiosk's cookie

column.name: kdev_Name
column.description: Name of the kiosk

column.name: kdev_deviceType
column.description: Kiosk device type

column.name: kdev_lastHeartbeat
column.description: Last time the kiosk sent a heartbeat

column.name: kdev_Accepted
column.description: Has the admin accepted the kiosk after initial registration?

column.name: kdev_PendingCommands
column.description: Commands waiting to be sent to the kiosk

column.name: kasm_AssignmentType
column.description: The kiosk's current role.

column.name: kasm_EventId
column.description: Optional. If the current role is for event check-in, populate this value

table.name: record2property_r2p
table.description: This table indicates which persons, families, or groups are assigned specific properties and what the values of those properties are.

foreign-key.description: This contains the definition of all person, family, and group properties

table.name: propertytype_prt
table.description: This contains all the defined property types

table.name: person2volunteeropp_p2vo
table.description: This table indicates which people are tied to which volunteer opportunities

table.name: event_audience
table.description: This is a join-table to link an event with a prospective audience for the purpose of advertising / outreach

table.name: locations
table.description: This is a table for storing all physical locations (Church Offices, Events, etc)

column.name: location_name
column.description: Location Name (e.g 'Main Campus')

table.name: calendar_events
table.description: This is a join-table to link an event with a calendar

table.name: query_qry
table.description: This contains all the predefined queries that appear in the queries page

table.name: queryparameteroptions_qpo
table.description: Defines the values for the parameters for each query

table.name: result_res
table.description: contains the results of authorizations from electronic payments

table.name: volunteer_ministry_vmin
table.description: Volunteer v2: an organizational area (Coffee Bar, Worship, Children's Ministry) that owns teams, positions, schedules and coordinator scope

column.name: vmin_Active
column.description: Deactivate rather than delete once occurrences exist

column.name: vmin_CreatedDate
column.description: Naive wall-clock in sTimeZone

table.name: volunteer_team_vtem
table.description: Volunteer v2: an operational team inside a ministry; the finest authorization scope. Exactly one level - ministries are never nested

table.name: volunteer_pool_vpol
table.description: Volunteer v2: links a ministry or team to an existing ChurchCRM group that acts as its volunteer pool. Stores no people - the group is the roster

column.name: vpol_OwnerType
column.description: Which table vpol_OwnerId points at

column.name: vpol_OwnerId
column.description: vmin_ID or vtem_ID. Polymorphic, so no database foreign key is possible - integrity is enforced in the service layer

column.name: vpol_Label
column.description: Optional coordinator label, e.g. "Sunday A team"

table.name: volunteer_position_vpos
table.description: Volunteer v2: a role a volunteer can serve in (Espresso, Song Leader, Nursery Teacher). Owned by a ministry, optionally narrowed to a team

column.name: vpos_vtem_ID
column.description: NULL means the position is ministry-wide

column.name: vpos_Description
column.description: Operational requirements for the position, as prose

column.name: vpos_Active
column.description: Deactivate rather than delete once assignments exist, so history survives

column.name: vpos_Order
column.description: Display order within the ministry

table.name: volunteer_qualification_vqal
table.description: Volunteer v2: person-to-position eligibility, many to many. Deliberately not a group role - person2group2role_p2g2r permits only one role per person per group

column.name: vqal_Active
column.description: Revocation is deactivation, never deletion, so historical assignments stay readable

table.name: volunteer_schedule_vsch
table.description: Volunteer v2: the recurring series V2 owns. Either linked to a ChurchCRM event type, in which case the event occurrences are authoritative, or standalone, in which case V2 generates its own dates

column.name: vsch_event_type_id
column.description: Required when LinkMode is event_type

column.name: vsch_TitleFilter
column.description: Optional LIKE narrowing when one event type carries several distinct services

column.name: vsch_RecurType
column.description: Standalone schedules only; a linked schedule never carries its own recurrence

column.name: vsch_WindowStart
column.description: No occurrence is ever generated before this date

column.name: vsch_WindowEnd
column.description: NULL means open ended

column.name: vsch_GenerateAheadDays
column.description: How far ahead a generation run materialises occurrences

table.name: volunteer_occurrence_vocc
table.description: Volunteer v2: one concrete opportunity to serve. When linked to an event the start and end times are read lazily from events_event and are NULL here; several occurrences from different schedules may point at the same event

column.name: vocc_event_id
column.description: When set, events_event is authoritative for date and time

column.name: vocc_OccurrenceDate
column.description: Sort and range-filter key. Non-authoritative when the occurrence is linked to an event

column.name: vocc_StartDateTime
column.description: Standalone occurrences only; naive wall-clock in sTimeZone

table.name: volunteer_requirement_vreq
table.description: Volunteer v2: how many people in which position an occurrence needs. Exactly one of the schedule (template) and occurrence (override) columns is set

column.name: vreq_vsch_ID
column.description: Template level

column.name: vreq_vocc_ID
column.description: Per-occurrence override

column.name: vreq_MinCount
column.description: The number below which a gap exists

column.name: vreq_MaxCount
column.description: NULL means the same as MinCount. Capacity ceiling for self-signup

table.name: volunteer_assignment_vasg
table.description: Volunteer v2: a person serving a position on an occurrence, with an explicit lifecycle. One row per person per position per occurrence - the same person may hold two different positions on one occurrence

column.name: vasg_vreq_ID
column.description: Which requirement this fills. Nullable so an assignment survives a requirement being restructured

column.name: vasg_AssignedBy_per_ID
column.description: NULL for self-signup

column.name: vasg_RespondedDate
column.description: Denormalised from the latest response row

column.name: vasg_Replaces_vasg_ID
column.description: Links a substitute back to the assignment it replaced

table.name: volunteer_response_vrsp
table.description: Volunteer v2: append-only history of every response to an assignment. Rows are never updated or deleted; vasg_Status is the denormalised current state

column.name: vrsp_per_ID
column.description: Who responded - the volunteer, or a coordinator acting on their behalf

table.name: volunteer_swap_vswp
table.description: Volunteer v2: a volunteer proposes a named substitute who has already agreed; a coordinator approves or rejects. Approval never edits the original assignment beyond its status, so the audit trail survives

column.name: vswp_vasg_ID
column.description: The original assignment being handed over

column.name: vswp_Proposed_per_ID
column.description: The substitute

table.name: volunteer_notification_vntf
table.description: Volunteer v2: the notification outbox. Idempotent enqueue keyed by vntf_DedupeKey, a due time, and a retry-safe send log drained by the background timer jobs

column.name: vntf_Channel
column.description: The delivery extension point; email is the only channel in the first release

column.name: vntf_vocc_ID
column.description: Used by gap_alert, which is not assignment scoped

column.name: vntf_DedupeKey
column.description: 190 rather than 255 to stay inside the InnoDB index prefix limit for utf8mb4

column.name: vntf_ScheduledFor
column.description: Naive wall-clock in sTimeZone; now() for immediate messages

table.name: volunteer_scope_vscp
table.description: Volunteer v2: persists that a person coordinates a ministry or leads a team. Keyed on the person, not the user, so a scope may be granted before the person has a login

column.name: vscp_ScopeId
column.description: vmin_ID or vtem_ID. Polymorphic, so no database foreign key is possible - integrity is enforced in the authorization service
